ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low high-intensity to low-intensity ratio; over 98% of the visible fluke surface consists of low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels with minimal specular reflections.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform, solid-state low-intensity distribution across both lobes; no high-contrast white mottling, geometric blobs, or focal spots detected on the main ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 40-50 degrees relative to the lobe baselines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations consisting of sharp peaks and shallow valleys across the entirety of the trailing edge on both left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory from the median notch transitioning into a distinct upward, out-swept curve at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, multi-tonal (white, tan, and brown) roughly circular pixel groups localized exclusively at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive, protruding calcified barnacle clusters (Coronula diadema) and associated scarring localized at the extreme lateral edges of both fluke lobes.
